CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  HELD VIA TELECONFERENCE
  Wednesday, April 14, 2021

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m. He stated that all comments should be sent to
  planning@cityoflaverne.org.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chairperson Simison led the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Jeff Allred, Phil May and Jason
  Simison. Not present: Thomas Allison (due to a conflict of interest as the only
  application on the agenda involved his employer’s property) and Jason Lorge.
  Advisory personnel present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City
  Attorney Bob Kress, Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  There was one public comment received.

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Mr. Scherer stated that the minutes were not ready for today’s meeting but will be
  ready for the next meeting.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6.  CASE NO. 105-20PPR & 106-20CUP – A PROPOSAL TO CONSTRUCT A
  NEW WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS FACILITY AT THE
  UNIVERSITY OF LA VERNE PARKING STRUCTURE.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1269

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO. 106-20CUP, A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  TO ALLOW AN AT&T MOBILITY WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS
  FACILITY WITHIN THE UNIVERSITY OF LA VERNE PARKING
  STRUCTURE LOCATED AT 2021 D STREET.
 Planning Commission Minutes
May 4, 2021
  Assistant Planner Gabriel Rivera presented his staff report.

  Chairperson Simison opened the Public Hearing.

  Applicant Will Kazimi of AT&T Wireless stated that the proposed facility was
  supposed to be on Bonita Unified property but due to community feedback they
  did not pursue. Mr. Kazimi prepared a presentation outlining all the locations that
  were explored and detailing the current gap in coverage.

  There was one public comment received via email.

  Chairperson Simison closed the Public Hearing.

  The Commissioners proceeded to ask questions regarding the design and parking.

  Mr. Rivera stated that there will be no changes to the current design and no loss of
  parking. Mr. Scherer stated that any proposed changes need planning approval.

  It was moved by Commissioner May and seconded by Commissioner Allred to
  approve Case No. 106-20CUP. Motion carried by a 3-0 vote.

OTHER MATTERS/INFORMATION

  Mr. Scherer announced that former Associate Planner Maia McCurley has started
  her new position with the City of Duarte. In the meantime, contract planner
  Vanessa Norwood of Sagecrest Planning and Environmental was brought in to
  assist with Maia’s large projects. Mr. Scherer also announced that Gabriel Rivera
  was promoted from Planning Intern to a full-time Assistant Planner.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:56 p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held May 12, 2021 at 6:30 p.m.

  ____________________________________________
  Chairperson, Planning Commission
